svg.text: The distillation curve — LLM tokens per fire, by purpose, per arm
Newest run of each arm per experiment. Shades split unify's spend into planning / verification / repair; proxy-metered arms report every token as planning.
silent_drift[units] — amount changes units before fire 5
silent_drift[page] — page cap halves before fire 5
edge_week[duplicate] — week 5 serves one invoice twice
edge_week[currency] — week 5 has a GBP invoice
edge_week[no_email] — week 5 has an invoice with no contact
change_without_regression — a column added before fire 4
× a fire the arm got wrong; ◐ a fire it held with a reason. Bars are the newest committed run per arm; an experiment with no runs yet is not drawn.
